To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
PZT/LaNiO 3 films with (0 0 1)-orientation can be obtained on bare Si(001) or SiO 2 (001)/Si substrates coated with a TiN buffer layer.
(0 0 1)-oriented P Z T / L N O heterostructures with high polarization and low coercive field can be grown on TiN/Si(0 0 0 2) and SiO2/Si(0 0 0 1) using pulsed laser deposition.
The PZT films are polycrystaline, and the crystallographic textures can be controlled by adjusting the background gas pressure.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the growth of (0 0 1)-oriented Pzt films on Si(0 0 1) substrates by PLD.
the growth of (0 0 1)-oriented Pb(Z r 0.52T i 0.48) O 3 /LaNiO 2 /TiN heterostructures by pulsed laser deposition on Si(0 00 1) and on SiO 2 –coated Si(00 0 1).
the development of a new approach for the growth of (001)-textured PzT thin films on Si substrates.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the (001)-oriented PZTs can be grown on Si(001), but only with a TiN buffer layer and a high background gas pressure.

(0 0 1)-textured Pb(Zr 52 Ti 48 )O 0.3 /LaNiO 0.7 /TiN heterostructures on Si(0 1 1) substrats with SiO 2 interlayers can be grown with optimized deposition conditions, which are suitable for the fabrication of nonvolatile ferroelectric memories.

(001)-oriented PZTs can be grown on bare Si(001) and SiO2/Si(001) substrats with TiN buffer layer by PLD, and the PZTs have high remnant polarizations and low coercive field, which can be used for the fabrication of high-performance ferroelectric nonvolatile random access memories.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

(0 0 1)-oriented PzT/LaNiO 3 films with good ferroelectric properties can be grown on Si(0 0 1)/SiO 2 /TiN substrates by PLD, which provides a promising approach to integrate PZT-based thin film capacitors with Si-based microelectronics devices.
(0 0 1)-oriented Pzt/LNO/TiO heterostructures on Si(0  0 1) or SiO 2/Si substrates can be obtained under optimized conditions and the films have excellent properties.
the PZT films grown on Si(0 00 1) and/or TiN buffer layers have good ferroelectric properties.
The main takeaway from our work is that

it is possible to grow high-quality PZT films on bare Si and SiO  / Si substrates with Ti buffer layers, and that the use of Ti buffer layers is essential for the growth of (0 0 1)-oriented P ZT films on bare or SiO 2 coated Si substrates.
the TiN buffer layer can effectively improve the (0 0 1)-orientation of PZT films grown by PLD on Si(0 01) substrates.
it is possible to grow (0 0 1)-oriented P Z T films on Si(0 00 1) and Si/SiO 2 substrates with Ti N buffer layers.
